name: How long does a typical kitchen window replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical kitchen window replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen window replacement project can vary. For a single window, installation often takes a few hours to a full day, including removal of the old window and finishing touches. If replacing multiple windows in the kitchen, the project might extend over several days. The total time depends on the number and type of windows, the complexity of the installation, and any necessary structural adjustments. Your contractor will provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific project.
acceptedAnswer.description: A single kitchen window replacement typically takes a few hours to a day, while multiple windows may extend over several days.
